summary: Implemented the plan's ruling end-to-end: git-commit-scoped.sh now classifies the git rm --cached untracking shape (content present on disk) before git add via a new V11 predicate, commits it through a guarded bare-commit path (V12) proven index-equivalent to the declared pathspec scope, and corrects the V8 pre-commit intent snapshot so a correctly landed untracking is never misreported as a partial commit. A six-case regression cluster (Y1-Y6) was added with a FAILS-before/PASSES-after demonstration, a durable recipe was documented in git-staging-scope.md, and the source store was redeployed with the REQUIRED OUTCOME confirmed end-to-end against the deployed script. Phase 5's full-gate verification was discharged per this dispatch's own Batch Gate Deferral directive via the scoped run-all.sh --only covering set (14 passed, 2 failed, both pre-existing and out of scope); an exploratory independent full verify-deploy.sh run surfaced 4 additional failures, all root-caused to cross-task noise from this same batch's concurrently-scheduled sibling tasks or an already-documented pre-existing finding, none attributable to this task's own three changed files.
